  "summary": "Implement category rename propagation to receipts and enable decimal mileage entry. Update renameCategory to also upsert any receipt whose category matches the old name (case‑insensitive) and ensure atomic rollback on failure. Extend validation.validateMileageMiles to accept numeric strings, enforce >0, ≤10 000 and a maximum of one decimal place, returning clear error messages. Add a new receipt‑update helper in receiptStore if needed. Add unit tests for the new mileage validation (including string and decimal cases) and acceptance tests that verify receipts are correctly renamed, that syncCategoriesWithReceipts no longer re‑introduces the old name, and that mileage entries with decimal miles are stored and deduced correctly. Extend the acceptance test generator to include the new milestone.",
  "files": [
    "src/lib/categories.ts",
    "src/lib/validation.ts",
    "test_acceptance.py",
    "__tests__/acceptance/m7.test.ts",
    "__tests__/validationMileage.test.ts"
  ],
  "steps": [
    "Open src/lib/categories.ts and locate the renameCategory function.",
    "Add imports for getAllReceipts and addReceipt from src/lib/receiptStore.",
    "After the existing rename logic (validation of oldName/newName and persisting the new category list), fetch all receipts with getAllReceipts(store).",
    "Iterate over receipts; for each receipt whose receipt.category matches oldName case‑insensitively, create a shallow copy with receipt.category set to newName and upsert it using addReceipt (which in the current implementation performs an INSERT OR REPLACE).",
    "Wrap the receipt‑update loop in a try/catch so that any error aborts the rename and leaves receipts untouched – ensure the rename only proceeds after the category list has been persisted successfully.",
    "Ensure renameCategory remains async and continues to return void (or whatever its original contract is).",
    "Open src/lib/validation.ts and locate validateMileageMiles.",
    "Change the function signature to accept unknown (or any) and coerce string inputs: if the argument is a string, attempt parseFloat; if parsing fails, return 'Miles must be a number'.",
    "Add checks: miles > 0 → error 'Miles must be > 0'; miles ≤ 10000 → error 'Miles must be ≤ 10,000'; enforce at most one decimal place – convert miles to string and inspect the fractional part, returning 'Miles can have at most 1 decimal place' when more than one digit follows the decimal point.",
    "Return null when all checks pass.",
    "Add a new Jest unit‑test file __tests__/validationMileage.test.ts that imports validateMileageMiles and asserts:",
    "  - validateMileageMiles(12.5) returns null",
    "  - validateMileageMiles(12.55) returns 'Miles can have at most 1 decimal place'",
    "  - validateMileageMiles('12.5') returns null (string is coerced to number)",
    "  - validateMileageMiles('abc') returns 'Miles must be a number'",
    "Create a new acceptance test file __tests__/acceptance/m7.test.ts containing two describe blocks:",
    "  1. 'M7: rename category updates receipts'",
    "     • Create a memory store, add a receipt with category 'Meals', verify receipt.category is 'Meals', then call renameCategory(store, 'Meals', 'Food & Dining').",
    "     • Retrieve receipts and assert the category is now 'Food & Dining'.",
    "     • Verify getAllCategories no longer includes 'Meals' and includes 'Food & Dining'.",
    "     • Call isCategoryInUse('Food & Dining') and expect true.",
    "     • Call syncCategoriesWithReceipts(store) and assert 'Meals' does not re‑appear.",
    "  2. 'M7: mileage entry accepts decimal miles'",
    "     • Add a mileage entry with miles: 12.5, then retrieve entries and assert miles is close to 12.5.",
    "     • Compute deduction with calculateMileageDeduction and assert the decimal deduction is correct (e.g., 12.5 × 0.585 ≈ 7.3125).",
    "Modify test_acceptance.py to add a new entry in the MILESTONE_TESTS map for milestone 7, pointing to the newly created m7.test.ts file.",
    "Run the full Jest suite locally to ensure existing tests still pass and the new tests succeed.",
    "Commit changes, run lint/tsc, and verify that the CI pipeline (including security scans) still passes."
  ],
  "has_ui": true,
  "tests": "jest"
}

export async function renameCategory(store: Store, oldName: string, newName: string): Promise<void> {
  if (!oldName || !newName) throw new Error('Category name cannot be empty');
  // Get current categories
  const categories = await getAllCategories(store);
  const oldIdx = categories.findIndex(c => c.name.toLowerCase() === oldName.toLowerCase());
  if (oldIdx === -1) throw new Error(`Category '${oldName}' not found`);
  const duplicate = categories.find(c => c.name.toLowerCase() === newName.toLowerCase());
  if (duplicate) throw new Error(`Category '${newName}' already exists`);
  // Validate newName pattern maybe (no invalid characters).
  // Continue rename

  // Save categories via store; maybe function persistCategories

  // Update receipts

  await Promise.all(
    receipts.map(r => {
      if (r.category && r.category.toLowerCase() === oldName.toLowerCase()) {
        const updated = { ...r, category: newName };
        return addReceipt(store, updated); // upsert
      }
      return Promise.resolve();
    })
  );
}

export async function renameCategory(store: Store, oldName: string, newName: string): Promise<void> {
  if (!oldName || !newName) throw new Error('Category name cannot be empty');
  // Get current categories
  const categories = await getAllCategories(store);
  const oldIdx = categories.findIndex(c => c.name.toLowerCase() === oldName.toLowerCase());
  if (oldIdx === -1) throw new Error(`Category '${oldName}' not found`);
  const duplicate = categories.find(c => c.name.toLowerCase() === newName.toLowerCase());
  if (duplicate) throw new Error(`Category '${newName}' already exists`);
  // Validate newName pattern maybe (no invalid characters).
  // Continue rename

  // Save categories via store; maybe function persistCategories

  // Update receipts

  await Promise.all(
    receipts.map(r => {
      if (r.category && r.category.toLowerCase() === oldName.toLowerCase()) {
        const updated = { ...r, category: newName };
        return addReceipt(store, updated); // upsert
      }
      return Promise.resolve();
    })
  );
}

```markdown
# DESIGN.md

## Users and goal
- **Primary persona** – freelancers, gig workers, and independent contractors who need a quick, private way to track income, expenses, and mileage **offline**.  
- **Goal** – Capture a receipt in ≤ 30 seconds by scanning a photo, edit any auto‑filled fields, pick a date from a calendar, select or create a category, and save.  
- **Success feels like** – “The receipt was scanned, the fields are correct, I tapped **Save**, and a snackbar says *Receipt saved*.”

## Primary flow
1. **Launch → Policy gate** (unchanged).  
2. **Dashboard** – bottom tab bar always visible.  
3. **Add receipt** – tap FAB → mini‑FAB **Receipt**.  
4. **Receipt entry** –  
   a. Tap **Scan receipt** → camera/gallery → OCR loading spinner.  
   b. If OCR finds data → fields pre‑filled, each shows helper *Check these details*.  
   c. If OCR finds nothing → alert *No details could be extracted – please enter manually*.  
   d. User edits any fields (date via calendar, category via dropdown, other fields).  
   e. If needed, tap **Add category…** → dialog to type a new name (1‑140 chars, case‑insensitive unique).  
   f. Tap **Save receipt** → loading → snackbar *Receipt saved*.  
5. **Settings → Categories** – rename, hide, or add custom categories (protected against deletion when in use).  
6. **Export / Backup / Restore** – unchanged and always reachable from bottom tabs or Settings.  

All screens expose a direct path forward; the bottom tab bar is present on every signed‑in screen.

## Screens and states

| Screen                     | State            | UI element(s)                                   | Message / copy                                                                 |
|----------------------------|------------------|-------------------------------------------------|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| **PolicyGateScreen**       | Loading          | Full‑screen `ActivityIndicator`                | “Checking policy version…”                                                      |
|                            | Default          | Policy text, checkbox, **Accept** button (disabled until checked) | Policy text                                                                     |
|                            | Error            | Full‑screen error view + **Retry**             | “Unable to store your acceptance. Please try again.”                           |
| **DashboardScreen**        | Loading          | Centered `ActivityIndicator`                    | —                                                                               |
|                            | Empty            | `EmptyState`                                    | Title *Nothing here yet*; Description *Add a receipt or mileage entry to start tracking your finances.*; Primary button **Add receipt** |
|                            | Populated        | 4 `SummaryCard`s + recent‑activity list        | —                                                                               |
| **ReceiptEntryScreen**     | Default (form)   | Photo picker, **Scan receipt** button, outlined `FormField`s (Amount, Date, Category, Type, Notes), **Save receipt** button (disabled until valid) | —                                                                               |
|                            | OCR loading      | Overlay `ActivityIndicator` + spinner label “Analyzing receipt…” | —                                                                               |
|                            | OCR success      | Fields pre‑filled; each shows `HelperText` *Check these details* (until edited) | —                                                                               |
|                            | OCR no data      | Alert dialog                                    | “No details could be extracted – please enter manually.”                       |
|                            | Date picker open | `DatePickerModal` (react‑native‑paper‑dates)    | —                                                                               |
|                            | Category dropdown open | `Menu` anchored to TextInput                | —                                                                               |
|                            | Add‑category dialog open | `Dialog` with TextInput                | Title *Add new category*; placeholder *Category name*                           |
|                            | Validation error (field) | `HelperText type="error"` under field   | Amount, Date, Category, Type messages (see Content)                             |
|                            | Saving           | **Save receipt** shows spinner, label hidden   | —                                                                               |
|                            | Save error       | `Snackbar`                                      | “Unable to save receipt. Please try again.”                                      |
| **MileageEntryScreen**     | Same as ReceiptEntryScreen but without photo & category; date picker allows future dates. | | |
| **SettingsScreen**         | Default          | List rows: App lock, Mileage rate, Tax rate, Export, Backup & Restore, **Categories**, Policy, Delete all data | — |
| **CategoriesScreen** (sub‑screen of Settings) | Default | List of categories with rename inline, hide toggle, **Add category…** button | — |
|                            | Rename mode      | Inline `TextInput` replaces label               | —                                                                               |
|                            | Add dialog open  | `Dialog` as above                               | —                                                                               |
|                            | Validation error | `HelperText type="error"` under input           | “Category must be 1‑40 characters.”; “Category already exists.”                |
|                            | Delete error (in‑use) | `Snackbar`                                  | “Category is used by receipts – hide instead.”                                   |
| **Any screen**             | Offline (where network would be used) | Full‑screen banner                | “You are offline. Some actions require an internet connection.”                 |

## Layout
- **Mobile‑first**: viewport **390 dp** wide; no horizontal scroll.  
- **Global container** – `Screen` component = `SafeAreaView` + `ScrollView` with **horizontal padding 16 dp** (`spacing*2`).  
- **Content width** – max **420 dp**; centered on desktop (1280 dp).  
- **Vertical rhythm** – 8 dp grid (4, 8, 12, 16, 24, 32 dp).  
- **Bottom Tab Bar** – fixed 56 dp height, icons + labels centered; anchored bottom on all platforms.  
- **FAB** – 56 × 56 dp, inset 16 dp from right & bottom; expands to two 40 × 40 dp mini‑FABs.  
- **Forms** – each `FormField` full‑width; vertical gap 12 dp.  
- **Receipt entry** – Scan button placed below photo picker, above other inputs. Date field shows calendar icon; Category field shows dropdown arrow.  
- **Settings → Categories** – list items stack vertically; inline rename appears in place; Add‑category button at bottom.  
- **Desktop breakpoint** – 1280 dp; layout unchanged, still phone‑first appearance.

## Design tokens
> **Implementation** – exported as a Material 3 theme object for React‑Native‑Paper (`src/theme.ts`) and mirrored as CSS custom properties (`public/theme.css`).

```ts
// src/theme.ts
export const theme = {
  roundness: 8,
  spacing: 8, // base unit (8 dp)

  colors: {
    // Primary (deep blue)
    primary: '#0061A4',
    onPrimary: '#FFFFFF',
    primaryContainer: '#CFE5FF',
    onPrimaryContainer: '#001D35',

    // Secondary (teal) – used for switches, mini‑FABs, active menu items
    secondary: '#015958',
    onSecondary: '#FFFFFF',
    secondaryContainer: '#C8F4EF',
    onSecondaryContainer: '#00201A',

    // Surfaces & background
    surface: '#FFFFFF',
    surfaceVariant: '#F2F2F2',
    background: '#F5F5F5',
    onSurface: '#212121',
    onSurfaceVariant: '#49454F',
    outline: '#79747E',
    disabled: '#E0E0E0',
    onDisabled: '#212121',
    placeholder: '#6F6F6F',

    // Status
    error: '#B00020',
    onError: '#FFFFFF',
  },

  typography: {
    displayLarge:   { fontSize: 57, lineHeight: 64, fontWeight: '400' },
    headlineMedium: { fontSize: 28, lineHeight: 36, fontWeight: '400' },
    titleMedium:    { fontSize: 16, lineHeight: 24, fontWeight: '500' },
    bodyLarge:      { fontSize: 16, lineHeight: 24, fontWeight: '400' },
    bodyMedium:     { fontSize: 14, lineHeight: 20, fontWeight: '400' },
    labelLarge:     { fontSize: 14, lineHeight: 20, fontWeight: '500' },
  },

  elevation: { level1: { elevation: 1, shadowOpacity: 0.2 } },
};
```

### Contrast pairs
| Foreground | Background | Use | Size |
|------------|------------|-----|------|
| #FFFFFF    | #0061A4    | Primary button label (contained) | normal |
| #0061A4    | #FFFFFF    | Text button / outlined button label | normal |
| #212121    | #FFFFFF    | Body text on screens & cards | normal |
| #49454F    | #FFFFFF    | Secondary text (captions, dates) | normal |

| #FFFFFF    | #0061A4    | Primary FAB icon | large (icon) |

All pairs meet **WCAG AA** (≥ 4.5:1 normal text, ≥ 3:1 UI).

## Components
All UI wrappers live in `src/components/ui/` and use React‑Native‑Paper primitives.
